messages:
Liam (BrightCart): heads up — after today's deploy some of our chat messages are getting an extra ``` at the top or missing the closing fence. Customers are seeing broken markdown in support tickets.

Priya (Support): thanks Liam. can you paste one of the payloads you sent and the raw response (not the rendered HTML)? API region and request_id would help.

Liam (BrightCart): sure. region: eu-central-1, request_id: req-e3f9b8a2. we POST to https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat.generate with body below and expected a fenced code block with closing ```, but the response either drops the final fence or inserts a stray ``` at the start of the next message.

Liam (BrightCart): request body:
```
{
  "model":"redwood-v2-small",
  "input":"Provide a bash snippet that echoes hello in a fenced block",
  "max_tokens":80,
  "stop":["\n```"],
  "temperature":0.0
}
```

Liam (BrightCart): raw truncated response:
```
{"id":"resp-789","choices":[{"text":"Here's the script:\n```\n#!/bin/bash\necho \"hello\"\n","index":0}],"model":"redwood-v2-small"}
```

Liam (BrightCart): the closing triple backtick is missing. in one thread we actually saw an extra ``` show up as a separate assistant message later in the stream which broke the UI rendering.

Eve (ML Eng): thanks for the repro. I pulled the request_id logs — I can reproduce locally with the same prompt. I believe this aligns with the token-boundary stop matcher change we rolled in canary-2026-03-11. That change requires the stop sequence to align with tokenizer boundaries; punctuation-heavy stops like a fence can be split across tokens depending on vocab and lead to unmatched stops.

Eve (ML Eng): sample tokenizer tokens around the fence for this case: ["\n`","``#","!/bin","/bash","\\necho"," \"hello\"","\\n"]. you can see the triple backtick isn't a single token so the stop matcher misses it.

Noah (SRE): if the stop matcher fails to trigger, the stream will continue until max_tokens or another stop. UI may then show an orphan ``` later when the next assistant chunk begins, leading to either missing closing fence or a stray fence token.

Priya (Support): is this strictly a canary regression? any customers hit in production yet?

Eve (ML Eng): looks like canary group B (eu-central-1) got the change. Impacted customers: BrightCart and one other small beta customer. We should roll back the canary in that region while we ship a safer matcher.

Noah (SRE): agreed. initiating rollback for canary group B.

DeployBot: rollback request created: rollback/canary-2026-03-11-token-boundary -> prior/canary-2026-03-10. Rolling back in eu-central-1 now.

CI Bot: automated verification running: smoke tests for chat.generate and stop sequences.

DeployBot: rollback completed on canary group B in eu-central-1 at 2026-03-12T16:45:10Z

Eve (ML Eng): verified against Liam's repro after rollback — closing fence restored. I'll open a PR to add a hybrid stop matcher (token-boundary preferred but fallback to char-level search for punctuation/newline-heavy stops) plus unit tests and a tokenization audit for fences and tilde fences. PR #4302. ETA 36 hours.

Priya (Support): Liam — engineering rolled back the canary in your region and we have a patch coming. can you recheck and confirm when you have a chance?

Liam (BrightCart): confirmed — I re-ran tests and fences look correct now. appreciate the quick fix.

Eve (ML Eng): follow-ups for postmortem: create test vectors for the following cases — triple-backtick fences, triple-tilde fences, mixed indenting, stop sequences with trailing quotes, and streaming/chunk boundary shims. also add monitoring alert for sudden spike in missing-fence patterns (heuristic: assistant message ends with non-newline and next assistant message starts with ```).

Priya (Support): I'll mark the ticket as resolved pending 24h stability. Thanks everyone.

Reaction: :white_check_mark: from Liam (BrightCart), :eyes: from Eve (ML Eng), :gear: from Noah (SRE)
